"""A placed order, persisted: one table row per order."""

from __future__ import annotations

from datetime import datetime
from decimal import Decimal
from typing import final

from advanced_alchemy.base import UUIDAuditBase
from advanced_alchemy.types import DateTimeUTC
from sqlalchemy import Numeric, String, Text
from sqlalchemy.orm import Mapped, mapped_column

__all__ = ["Order"]


@final
class Order(UUIDAuditBase):
    """One placed order.

    Attributes:
        number: The human-readable number.
        total: What it costs.
    """

    __tablename__ = "orders"

    number: Mapped[str] = mapped_column(String(32), unique=True)  # shown to the customer
    total: Mapped[Decimal] = mapped_column(Numeric(10, 2))
    note: Mapped[str | None] = mapped_column(Text, nullable=True)
    placed_at: Mapped[datetime] = mapped_column(DateTimeUTC(timezone=True))

    def label(self) -> str:
        """Return the number as printed on the receipt."""
        return f"#{self.number}"
